_: TRADITIONAL CHINESE (zh_hant / 台灣) KEY TEXT. Authored 2026-09-11 NATIVELY from Dreame's own Traditional-Chinese manuals - no English>Chinese hop. Sources, all in manuals/language-source/: x50-pad/zh_hant.pdf (the Taiwan ZH-TW edition, authoritative for every term it covers: robot, dock, dust bin, brushes, sensors, wheel, tanks, mop pad), x50-pad/zh_hk.pdf, d20-cloth/zh_hk.pdf (cloth / mopping module), aqua10-roller/zh_hk.pdf (roller, robot used-water box, washboard, heating module). The zh_hk books are Dreame's Hong Kong edition - same script, first-party - and where their wording is HK-specific the Taiwan standard form was used instead; every such swap is listed in the review flags. RE-CHECKED 2026-09-11 against manuals/language-source/_text/x60-track-global__zh_hk.txt - Dreame's Hong Kong slice (12 pages) of the 34-language X60 Master book - with the four mop.track_* keys as the target. IT DOES NOT SOURCE THEM. Despite the file name, that book is a PAD machine: its 拖布組件 is figure A-3's 拖布黏貼區 + 拖布盤 + 拖布, the robot underside carries 拖布盤安裝孔, its maintenance section reads 「取下並清理拖布盤。」 (E-6) and 「從拖布盤上取下拖布進行更換。」 (E-12), and its troubleshooting entry is 「拖布盤異常抬升。」 The same book's English slice contains the word bracket zero times and rotate zero times, and there is no 旋轉/轉動 anywhere in the Chinese. Its two 支架 hits are 主刷支架, the MAIN BRUSH bracket. So the four track keys remain COMPOSED and their strings were left byte-identical; as of this date Dreame still publishes no Traditional-Chinese edition of a track machine.
_register: CHINESE HAS NO GENDER, NUMBER OR CASE AGREEMENT, so the shared keys are not at risk from agreement - they are at risk from two other things: PRONOUNS and CLASSIFIERS. The classifier is Chinese's analogue of gender: a mop pad is 一片拖布, a side brush 一支邊刷, an omnidirectional wheel 一顆萬向輪, a tank 一個水箱 - so the moment a shared key determines or counts its object it has to pick one, and picks wrong for every other part. THE DEVICE IS THE VENDOR'S OWN: the ZERO-OBJECT IMPERATIVE (零形賭語, 承前省略) - a bare verb phrase whose object is recovered from the topic already established, which here is the component name the card prints as the panel heading. Dreame writes exactly this whenever a maintenance step continues from its own heading: 「充分晾乾後方可裝回使用。」 (x50-pad zh_hant p.20) and 「取下拖布後請僅用清水清潔，充分晾乾後方可裝回使用。」 (d20-cloth zh_hk p.8) carry no object, no pronoun and no classifier at all. An objectless verb phrase needs no classifier by construction. COMPONENT-SPECIFIC keys drop back into the manuals' ordinary numbered-step register, which always names its part (「取出污水箱，打開污水箱上蓋，傾倒污水。」). NOTES take the manuals' 提示 register: 請 / 請勿 / 切勿. No shared key contains 它, 其 or a classifier.
_vocabulary: Dreame's own Traditional Chinese, taken from the parts tables and the 日常維護 sections rather than invented. Taiwan form preferred wherever the ZH-TW edition supplies one: 主機 (robot) · 基座 (base station) · 主機面蓋 (robot cover) · 集塵盒 (dust bin) · 集塵盒濾網 (dust bin filter) · 濾網邊框 (filter frame) · 集塵袋 (dust bag) · 滾刷 (main brush, ZH-TW; the HK books say 主刷) · 滾刷罩 (brush guard) · 邊刷 (side brush) · 刷毛 (bristles) · 感測器 (sensor, ZH-TW; HK 感應器) · 透視窗 (sensor window, from 防撞板透視窗) · 充電接觸點 (charging contacts) · 訊號發射區 (signal area, ZH-TW; HK 信號發射區) · 萬向輪 (omnidirectional wheel) · 主輪 (main wheels) · 主機底部 (underside of the robot) · 安裝孔 (mounting hole) · 插槽 (slot) · 拖布 (mop pad) · 拖布盤 (mop pad holder / carriage) · 拖布組件 (mop assembly) · 拖地模組 (mopping module, d20 zh_hk heading) · 拖布組件模組 (mop assembly module, aqua10 zh_hk) · 絨毛滾軸 (roller mop, aqua10 zh_hk) · 污水箱 (dirty / used-water tank, dock-side and on-robot alike) · 清水箱 (clean water tank) · 水箱 (the robot's own tank) · 浮球 (float ball) · 活動零件 (movable part) · 清洗盤 (washboard) · 清洗盤濾網 (washboard filter) · 加熱模組 (heating module) · 水垢 (limescale) · 白醋 / 除垢劊 (white vinegar / descaler) · 柔軟乾布 (soft dry cloth) · 乾抹布 (dry cloth) · 合適的工具 (suitable tool) · 纏繞的毛髮 (tangled hair) · 充分晾乾 (dry fully) · 清潔劊 (detergent) · 密封圈 (seal) · 回氣孔 (air hole) · 注水蓋 (filler cap) · 自來水 (tap water) · 黏稠物 (sticky residue) · 敏感的電子元件 (sensitive electronics). ADDED 2026-09-11 for the re-authored keys, all lifted from the books rather than coined: 清空集塵盒 (empty the dust bin - verbatim step 2 of the 「集塵盒和濾網」 section, x50-pad zh_hk p.26 and d20-cloth zh_hk, where the filter comes off first and the emptying clause carries no cover-opening) · 放回基座 (put the robot back on the dock - x50-pad zh_hant p.16 「手動將主機放回基座」, same sentence in x50-pad zh_hk and aqua10-roller zh_hk) · 從拖布組件模組中取出 (out of the mop assembly module - aqua10-roller zh_hk F-10 labels ① 拖布組件模組 as the cavity the 絨毛滾軸 sits in, and its step 1 is 「從主機上取出拖布組件及絨毛滾軸」). ATTESTED BUT NOT ADOPTED AS A SOURCE, x60-track-global zh_hk 2026-09-11: 支架 is Dreame's own Traditional-Chinese noun for the bracket a rotating part seats into, but the only referent the books attest is 主刷支架 (「將刷子用力推入至主刷支架」, 「將主刷支架向下傾斜插入插槽」, p.8) - the mop-side 支架 in mop.track_detach_from_bracket and mop.track_hair_in_bracket is that vendor noun REUSED onto a part the vendor has never named in this script, not a sourced term, and it stays distinct from 拖布組件 (assembly) and 拖布盤 (pad holder). 插槽 (slot) is attested in the same two sentences, again of the main-brush housing. 清除纏繞在…上的毛髮 is the vendor's own hair-clearing frame verbatim (「使用合適的工具，清除纏繞在主刷上的毛髮。」 p.8) and is already the construction mop.track_hair_in_bracket uses. 此為正常狀況 is this HK book's reassurance formula (「取出清水箱時，會有部分管道內的水殘留…此為正常狀況。」 p.10); Taiwan standard 正常現象 is kept instead, by the same HK->TW rule as 感測器/滾刷/訊號發射區.
access.brush_guard: 取下滾刷罩，向上取出滾刷。
access.dust_bin: 掀開主機面蓋，向上取出集塵盒。
contacts.dock_side_too: 基座的充電接觸點與訊號發射區也請以相同方式擦拭。
dry.fully_before_refit: 充分晾乾後方可裝回使用。
filter.remove_and_tap: 取下集塵盒濾網，輕拍濾網邊框，將灰塵抖落。
mop.cloth_module_off: 將拖地模組從主機上取下。
mop.cloth_pad_off_module: 將拖布從模組上取下，兩者都要清洗。
mop.cloth_pour_out_water: 先倒出模組水箱內殘留的水，再進行後續清潔。
mop.compartment_and_filter: 清潔拖布組件模組與其後方的濾網，避免造成堵塞。
mop.holders_remove: 將拖布盤從插槽中取出。
mop.holders_to_corresponding_slots: 每個拖布盤都要裝回原來的插槽。基座是依插槽來選用拖布，插錯位置就會把錯誤的拖布送到錯誤的房間，而且不會有任何提示。
mop.pad_carriages_off: 將拖布盤從主機上取下。
mop.pad_clean_all_four: 四個零組件都要清潔：兩片拖布與兩個拖布盤。
mop.pad_off_carriage: 將每一片拖布從拖布盤上取下。
mop.pads_off_holders_and_clean: 將拖布從拖布盤上取下，兩者都要清洗；顏色是配對的，每一片拖布都要裝在同色的拖布盤上。
mop.roller_release_and_lift: 將拖布組件從其模組中取出。
mop.track_hair_in_bracket: 不只是拖布，連纏繞在支架上的毛髮也要一併清除。
mop.track_release_assembly: 鬆開拖布組件，將其從主機中取出。
note.filter_no_brush_finger_sharp: 請勿使用刷子、手指或尖銳物品清理濾網，以免刮破網面、失去密封效果。
note.no_detergent: 僅可用清水清洗，請勿添加任何清潔劑。
note.see_user_manual: 詳細說明與警告請參閱使用說明書。
note.side_brush_do_not_yank: 毛髮纏繞得太緊時，請慢慢鬆開或剪斷，切勿用力拉扯，以免刷毛永久變形。
note.wet_cloth_damages_sensors: 抹布務必保持乾燥；濕氣一旦滲入感測器透視窗後方，內部敏感的電子元件將永久損壞。
rinse.bin_and_filter_clean_water: 僅可用清水沖洗集塵盒及濾網。
side.rinse_if_soiled: 若邊刷沾到水漬或黏稠物，請用清水沖洗，並充分晾乾後再裝回。
tool.remove_tangled_hair: 清除纏繞的毛髮；若無法徒手取下，可使用合適的工具。
washboard.allow_cooling_before_service: 若基座配有加熱清洗盤，請預留充裕的時間，待清洗盤完全冷卻後再進行維護。
washboard.filter_if_fitted: 若基座配有清洗盤濾網，請一併用清水沖洗、擦拭乾淨，然後裝回清洗盤內。
washboard.wipe_base: 將清洗盤下方的底槽擦拭乾淨。
wheel.omnidirectional_remove: 將輪子從安裝孔中拔出。
wheel.wipe_other_wheels: 用乾布擦拭主輪，以及主機底部其他的輪子。
wipe.compartment_soft_dry_cloth: 請用柔軟乾布將空出的凹槽內部擦拭乾淨。
wipe.soft_dry_cloth: 請用柔軟乾布擦拭乾淨。
